designs.name:
1. 你是 I 人还是 E 人？
Are you an Introvert or Extrovert?
选项：Introvert (I) / Extrovert (E)
2. 你会和 AI 倾诉心事吗？
Do you share your deep thoughts with AI?
选项：Yep / Nope
3. 你的隐藏性格：三分钟热度，还是慢热？
Are you quick to lose interest or slow to warm up?
选项：Quick to lose interest / Slow to warm up
4. 你知道自己的 MBTI 人格类型吗？
Do you know your MBTI personality type?
选项：Yes / No
5. 做决定时，你更相信直觉还是理性思考？
When making choices, do you trust your gut or logic?
选项：Trust my gut / Use logic
6. 空闲时间，更喜欢独处还是和朋友聚会？
In your free time, do you prefer alone time or hanging out with friends?
选项：Alone time / Hang with friends
7. 遇到烦恼，你习惯先说出来，还是自己消化？
When stressed, do you vent right away or keep it to yourself?
选项：Vent right away / Keep it to myself
8. 计划出行：喜欢详细规划，还是随性走一步看一步？
For trips, are you a planner or go-with-the-flow?
选项：Planner / Go with the flow
9. 面对新认识的人，你容易主动搭话吗？
Do you easily start conversations with new people?
选项：Yep / Nope
10. 刷内容，你更喜欢新奇刺激的，还是治愈舒缓的？
Do you prefer thrilling content or calm, cozy content?
选项：Thrilling content / Cozy calm content
